info.name: Forem API V1 agent_sessions trends API

params.name: per_page
params.description: Page size (the number of items to return per page). The default maximum value can be overridden by "API_PER_PAGE_MAX" environment variable.

items.docs:
This endpoint allows the client to retrieve a list of active trends.

Trends represent topics or themes that are currently hot and heavily discussed in the community.
It will return trends ordered by score and recency.

It supports pagination, each page will contain 10 trends by default.

params.name: id_or_slug
params.description: The ID or slug of the trend to retrieve.

items.docs: This endpoint allows the client to retrieve details of a single trend using either its numeric ID or unique slug.

params.name: trend_id_or_slug
params.description: The ID or slug of the trend to retrieve articles for.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Page size (the number of items to return per page). The default maximum value can be overridden by "API_PER_PAGE_MAX" environment variable.

items.docs:
This endpoint allows the client to retrieve a list of published articles belonging to a trend.

Articles will be ordered by their proximity (distance) to the trend's centroid, then by article score.
It supports pagination, each page will contain 10 articles by default.
